raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5012 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_id values (ids 900001–904866 are contiguous), so 146 rows are redelivered copies of transactions already loaded. The silver step has no dedup, so 137 POSTED txn_ids appear twice and inflate every gold aggregate. The proportions (about 95% of the extras are POSTED, matching the overall POSTED rate) suggest exact redeliveries; I could not confirm this from samples. The fix keeps one row per txn_id, the latest-ingested version, before applying the existing POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
